check_dependencies_at_runtime: check all runtime dependencies against required version constraints defined in the dependency table
verify_package_version: verify a specific package version matches the required constraint using dep_version_check
validate_dependency_table: validate that all packages in pkgs_to_check_at_runtime exist in the dependency versions table
check_tokenizers_availability: check if tokenizers is installed before enforcing its version requirement
check_accelerate_availability: check if accelerate is installed before enforcing its version requirement
